title: IPC session.losses result
description: The broadcasts this data connection's session has lost since it opened (IPC 2.11, architect-cto's ruling of 2026-10-24): two monotonic counts that never fall while the connection lives. queue_overflow counts copies the session's own queue dropped -- its oldest, to take a newer one -- or could not queue; ingress_refused counts broadcasts the ingress gate refused (over the publisher's rate, or while draining) on a channel the session held at the time, since that join. Both are LOWER BOUNDS: what GossipSub dropped before admission (validation, mesh, the backend's queue) and a conflicting body are not counted, so zero means none counted, not none lost. A broadcast every joined session lost keeps its dedup entry, so a republish of the same id is a duplicate and the loss is permanent. No peer and no channel is named. Params: the empty object.

queue_overflow.description: Copies this session's queue dropped or could not queue, since it opened.

ingress_refused.description: Broadcasts the ingress gate refused on a channel this session held, since each join.
